messages.subject: Statet install : jvm.dll missing
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am interested in using Statet, but the R Console doesn't launch. The critical point is that rj.gd doesn't find jvm.dll on my system. However, java is up to date, and I found this dll in C:\Program Files (x86)\Java\jre1.8.0_66\bin\client\jvm.dll. I tried to launch the package from Eclipse or from R, same result. I went through the mailing list archive, but this issue doesn't seem to appear before.

My configuration :
Windows 7
Java Version 8 Update 66
R 3.1.3
Eclipse Luna 4.4.2
Statet installation (from Eclipse "Installation details" menu)
StatET for R                                                                                                                      3.4.2.b201506120830E44sw                de.walware.statet.r.feature.group                        WalWare.de
StatET for R - R tasks Add-on for Contingency Tables ('ftable')                  1.0.1.b201506120830E44sw                de.walware.statet.rtm.ftable.feature.group     WalWare.de
StatET for R - R tasks Add-on for Graphics ('ggplot')                                       1.0.1.b201506120830E44sw                de.walware.statet.rtm.ggplot.feature.group    WalWare.de
StatET for R - Sweave Add-on                                                                                 3.4.2.b201506120830E44sw                de.walware.statet.r.sweave.feature.group       WalWare.de
RJ version : 2.0.4-2
Rj.gd version : 2.0.0-1

I hope I provided enough details, and that this would allow you to help me !

Sincerely yours,

David LAFOND

messages.subject: Re: Statet install : jvm.dll missing
messages.body_plain:
Hi David,

The R packages rj and rj.gd are designed for RJ, that means they doesn't 
work in other contexts like RTerm or RGui.

Did you start the R console in StatET in the default launch type "RJ" 
(first setting in the launch configuration)?

But the console doesn't start at all? What is the exact error message?

Regards,
Stephan
